text:
Zoe (growth): heads up — webinar signups jumped overnight but channel mix shows big organic bump. can someone pull the funnel and click logs?
Marcus (analytics): pulling funnel now. link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/webinar-funnel?range=24h
Marcus (analytics): signup +320 vs baseline, but paid spend only +8%. conversion rate from paid is flat. looks like attribution dropped for a subset.
Kendra (ops): quick lookup on click exports: 1,150 clicks between 23:40-00:40 UTC. 47 clicks missing utm_campaign entirely, campaign present on the rest.
Zoe (growth): weird — we didn't change email/UAs. any infra changes?
DevBot: cdn-config-deploy finished at 23:30 UTC. 0 errors. changed rule: edge-redirect-cache=enabled for /r/* paths.
Marcus (analytics): aha. samples show the /r/ redirect path returned a cached 302 that lost query params for repeat edge hits. mobile clients are hitting the cached redirect and losing utm_campaign.
Lucas (product): that's the new performance redirect rule we enabled last sprint to lower TTL. didn't realize some clients rely on query passthrough.
Kendra (ops): filed ticket MKT-6101 "edge cache 302 strips query on /r/ redirects" and pinned to eng-edge. assigning to infra.
Zoe (growth): operational asks: 1) annotate the weekly KPI dashboard with the event; 2) flag affected leads in the KPI sheet; 3) hold automated nurture for those leads until reclassification.
Marcus (analytics): will add annotation and compute pre/post CAC impact once we rejoin. preliminary delta: if 47 leads reclass to paid, CAC would increase by ~12% for this cohort.
Kendra (ops): temporary mitigation: disable edge-redirect-cache for /r/* to restore passthrough. infra rollback queued. ETA 40m.
DevBot: rollback job infra-edge-rollback-377 queued.
Lucas (product): product note: we should add automated tests for query-param preservation on edge redirects. creating follow-up: PROD-224.
Marcus (analytics): scheduling rejoin/reproc for 23:30-00:40 UTC window after rollback. job id: reproc-377-2026-03-25. will post sample when done.
Zoe (growth): please add a one-line narrative to Friday KPI deck: "03/25 temporary attribution drift due to edge redirect caching; 47 leads reclassified after reproc; metrics updated post-rejoin."
Kendra (ops): holding nurture: adding CRM tag "hold-edge-reclass" to 47 lead ids. also removing them from the next reminder cohort.
Marcus (analytics): sample posted: https://s3.redwood.com/exports/edge-reclass-sample-377.csv (10 leads shown; 47 total reclassified). reproc job completed: reproc-377-2026-03-25.
Zoe (growth): thanks. follow-ups: Kendra  rollback + CRM hold; Marcus  reproc numbers and updated CAC; Lucas  add prod test to backlog. will brief execs in Friday sync and include slide with pre/post numbers. :white_check_mark:
